description: Inventario de luminarias Palmira is a dataset listed in Colombian national open data portal (datos.gov.co), an open data portal (Socrata), published or maintained by Alcaldía de Palmira, Valle del Cauca. Coverage: Alcaldía de Palmira, Valle del Cauca. The portal files it under the publisher Alcaldía de Palmira, Valle del Cauca. Its tags are alcaldia de palmira, luminarias, palmira. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-SA-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-datos-gov-co-portal.
